world_title.description: The title of the world scenario.

selected_tags.description: Zero to eight exact strings copied from the provided allowed-tags pool. Include only direct, core components of the world's scenario or rules; do not invent, paraphrase, or explain tags.

mature.description: Whether the world contains explicit or otherwise mature content. Use true only for overt adult or explicit material; otherwise false.

description.description: An end-user-facing blurb of one or two short sentences highlighting the world's setting, premise, and central appeal without major spoilers.
